prompt: According to the WHO, in which year were the highest number of measles cases recorded worldwide?
answer: According to the WHO’s latest estimates, **2024** had the highest number of measles cases since the COVID-19 pandemic began—about **11 million cases worldwide**. It was the **second-highest estimated total since 2003**.
